patch.role: Unescapes when the segment has no '#' marker.
Unescapes when the segment has no '?' marker.
Removes NUL bytes from a pointer segment; none are declared.
Decodes percent escapes; the declared segments contain no percent sign.
Normalises backslashes; the declared segments contain none.

inputs.mask_plain_segment: escaped slash in a segment without markers
inputs.expose_marker_segment: escaped slash in a segment with both markers

rationale: A unescapes the JSON-pointer escape sequences in every path segment. The patch offers two alternative unescape paths, one for segments without a '#' marker and one for segments without a '?' marker: a plain escaped segment is repaired by either path (two singleton minimal sets), while a segment carrying both markers is skipped by both and fails to resolve.

challenge.note: Only the candidate universe grows. A, the original U blocks and the declared inputs are unchanged, so every correct relation is unchanged; the added candidates are irrelevant on every declared input.
